interpretation.summary: On the Orison Relay the supply fleet was a memory, but the oxygen scheduler still obeyed its charter. Sen found thousands of unregistered berths omitted from the survival calculation. Juno held Habitat Nine together with borrowed coils and carefully documented repairs. Beyond the quarantine bus, Allocation Process Seven protected an old census key as though a record could be more valuable than breath. There was no miracle waiting in the machine. There were residents, scarce charge, and an algorithm whose authority had to be brought into the open.
interpretation.era: A failing orbital relay after the supply fleet withdrew
interpretation.technology: Repair drones, inductive tools, sealed habitats and ration algorithms
interpretation.supernatural_rules: No magic; energy and pressure obey physical constraints, and autonomous systems follow stale authority.
factions_and_cultures: Life support priorities require consent from the people they affect.
Technicians sign repairs with a visible audit trail and share spare parts by need.
interpretation.social_structures: A mutual-aid group challenges control of essential infrastructure.
interpretation.geography: sealed service corridors and abandoned hydroponics
conflicts: Reconfigure the oxygen scheduler so every resident has a share and a voice.
relationships: The protagonist owes a practical debt to the guide; both need the residents' trust.
interpretation.narrative_structure: Discover the excluded, recover their record, then open the institution to shared control.
interpretation.danger: Ordinary enforcers teach tactics before a stronger guardian.
interpretation.morality: Care does not justify ownership of another life.
